Subject: Post-signature: Onboarding sprint & canary ops playbook

Elena / Kyle —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get MedNexa into production. Attached is our recommended MAP-first implementation pack: a one-page sprint plan, evaluation plan, and a migration checklist we use for similar engagements. High level proposal below and asks to unblock scheduling.

Proposed 4-week cadence (target go-live window in Week 5):
- Week 0: Final confirmation + procurement handoff (we'll trigger infra prep)
- Week 1: Integration & basic verification (sandbox traffic)
- Week 2: Canary run (1% production traffic) + eval ramps
- Week 3: Migration & training (data validation, runbooks)
- Week 4: Hypercare + rollback window

Key asks for Monday:
1) Confirm procurement contact & billing start date (cc'ed procurement@mednexa.com is fine).
2) Share two engineer availability windows for Week 1 sprint.
3) Review the attached MAP and call out any compliance gating items we should pre-check.

Attachments: MedNexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), evaluation-playbook.pdf, migration-checklist.csv

Thanks — I can hop on a quick 20m tomorrow to walk through the plan if helpful.

Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature: Onboarding sprint & canary ops playbook

Thanks Elena — that helps. A few operational notes and an initial evaluation plan excerpt (see evaluation-playbook.pdf attached):

1) VPC / network: VPC peering is supported for Private deployments; if you want Hosted with VPC Connect, we can provision a dedicated gateway. We'll surface options in the kickoff call and record the decision in the MAP.

2) Canary cadence: recommend a 3-day canary window with metrics gates at 6h, 24h, and 72h. Sample gates: 95th latency, error rate, and token-cost per request. If any gate trips, automatic fallback to capped-hosted variant for 24h.

3) Eval plan: we'll run the shared prompt suite (attached) across the canary traffic and report regression deltas. Owner: Ben Carter (ops lead). Deliverables: daily canary dashboard, end-of-canary quality report, and a roll-forward checklist.

4) Training: propose two 90m workshops during Week 3 — Admin runbook + Incident response. Laura will lead the Admin workshop.

Next steps: Kimberly, can you book a 30m kickoff for Fri 10/15? I can prepare the canary gates doc and a basic Grafana dashboard.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Implementation Services
Redwood Inference

> 3) Eval plan: we'll run the shared prompt suite (attached) across the canary traffic and report regression deltas. Owner: Ben Carter (ops lead).

Adding operational windows and migration checklist notes:
- Sandbox to staging migration: zero-downtime approach — route 10% of traffic to staging during Week 2 day 2, then to canary as we validate.
- Canary times: propose Wed-Fri of Week 2 (UTC-friendly windows: 16:00-20:00 UTC) to align with MedNexa's peak off-hours.
- Migration cut: plan a 2-hour low-risk migration slot in Week 3 morning PT; we'll have rollback snapshot prepared.

Please confirm the Wed-Fri canary window and the 2-hour migration slot (we'll hold a tentative calendar hold).

Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead
